description:
## Goal

Make activation-input contribution storage explicit and delete the one-consumer generic ContributionMap abstraction without changing update semantics yet.

## Evidence

ContributionMap<K,P,V> was introduced to unify ActivationInputMap and ReturnDemandMap. ReturnDemandMap was deleted; only ActivationInputMap remains in production. JoinContribution implementations for RuntimeDemand and Vec<Ty> are orphaned. Generic context plumbing also places activation-input collapse bookkeeping on Types even though it is not type state.

## Strategy and proof

1. Land duplicate-contribution removal and resolve activation-row antichain confluence first.
2. Introduce a focused ActivationInputMap with the same rebuild oracle and publisher ordering.
3. Move collapse bookkeeping to the semantic store that owns it.
4. Delete ContributionMap, ContributionSlot, JoinContribution, orphan RuntimeDemand/Vec implementations, generic-only tests, and generic context plumbing.
5. Differentially compare the specialized store with the pre-change implementation over insertion, equal update, ascent, rebase, and withdrawal histories.
6. Prove identical activation rows, collapse events, semantic answers, causal work, and artifacts.
7. Run full tests, fixture matrix, determinism, formatting, and strict clippy.

This ticket changes ownership and removes abstraction only. Change-aware incremental reconciliation is a separate child so each PR has one claim.
title: Specialize ActivationInputMap and delete the orphaned contribution abstraction
